verse.verse_1: When the Sky is cleft asunder;
verse.verse_3: When the Oceans are suffered to burst forth;
verse.verse_4: And when the Graves are turned upside down;-
verse.verse_5: (Then) shall each soul know what it hath sent forward and (what it hath) kept back.
verse.verse_6: O man! What has seduced thee from thy Lord Most Beneficent?-
verse.verse_7: Him Who created thee. Fashioned thee in due proportion, and gave thee a just bias;
verse.verse_8: In whatever Form He wills, does He put thee together.
verse.verse_9: Nay! But ye do reject Right and Judgment!
verse.verse_10: But verily over you (are appointed angels) to protect you,-
verse.verse_11: Kind and honourable,- Writing down (your deeds):
verse.verse_12: They know (and understand) all that ye do.
verse.verse_13: As for the Righteous, they will be in bliss;
verse.verse_14: And the Wicked - they will be in the Fire,
verse.verse_15: Which they will enter on the Day of Judgment,
verse.verse_16: And they will not be able to keep away therefrom.
verse.verse_17: And what will explain to thee what the Day of Judgment is?
verse.verse_18: Again, what will explain to thee what the Day of Judgment is?
verse.verse_19: (It will be) the Day when no soul shall have power (to do) aught for another: For the command, that Day, will be (wholly) with Allah.
